facts.text: Pull up a chair and grab a burger. We'll argue about movies till the fries go cold.
facts.why: Set out as Randal's words under 'A word from the house', but he never says it. His real run of lines is the Lord of the Rings versus Star Wars argument with Elias, for example 'there's only one Return, okay? And it ain't of the King, it's of the Jedi.'
facts.fix: Grab a burger and a seat. Say Return of the King beats Jedi and we have a problem.
